entries.title: Bits
entries.description: The Mempool Market’s currency. Minted for each verified night; spent at Gwei’s stall, on crafting, or invested in a merchant’s till.

entries.title: Fee bomb
entries.description: Defused. Mostly. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (common).

entries.title: Goblin glider
entries.description: Still smells of exhaust. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (rare).

entries.title: Crumbs
entries.description: Left behind by Sandwich Man. Always. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (common).

entries.title: Golden sesame seed
entries.description: From the top bun. Weirdly heavy. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (uncommon).

entries.title: Chain link
entries.description: One of very many. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (common).

entries.title: Doc’s spare arm
entries.description: It still twitches when bridges open. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (rare).

entries.title: Sybil goo
entries.description: There’s always more of it. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (uncommon).

entries.title: Press pass
entries.description: Signed by Bearson, who regrets it. Loot from verified nights in With Great Power (uncommon).

entries.title: Classic suit
entries.description: The original. Red, webbed, recognizable from three blocks.

entries.title: Midnight suit
entries.description: For heroes who mostly work nights. Which is all of them.

entries.title: Mainnet mint suit
entries.description: Black and mint, like a certain blockchain.

entries.title: Snow suit
entries.description: Very clean. Very hard to keep clean.

entries.title: Stealth suit
entries.description: Woven from Sybil goo. Nobody can tell which one is you.

entries.title: Glider suit
entries.description: Stitched from a goblin glider. Comes with a faint cackle.

entries.title: Octo rig suit
entries.description: Doc’s spare arm, repurposed. It mostly behaves.

entries.title: Sesame suit
entries.description: Smells like the Mempool Market at lunch.

entries.title: Day one badge
entries.description: Played With Great Power on its first day on mainnet. Soulbound.

entries.title: Case file 001 badge
entries.description: Closed case file 001, Missing: Mary Jpeg. Soulbound.

entries.title: Case file 002 badge
entries.description: Closed case file 002, The Sybil Vote. Soulbound.

entries.title: Case file 003 badge
entries.description: Closed case file 003. Soulbound.

entries.title: Daily podium badge
entries.description: Finished a Daily Run in the top three. Soulbound.

entries.title: Daily winner badge
entries.description: Won a Daily Run. Soulbound.

entries.title: Recruiter badge
entries.description: Brought three friends who played a verified night. Soulbound.
